'''Tritt Opan''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] who served in the [[First Order Navy|naval forces]] of the [[First Order]]. Holding the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[captain]], he was among the staff of [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]], and acted as his hitman to [[Death|kill]] anyone who might pose a threat to the general, with some of his devices including a fake [[code cylinder]] that contained [[poison]]. Owing to his knowing about and being involved in these [[assassin]]ations, he also kept firmly silent about this, knowing full well that Hux could silence him in the future if he decided so.<ref name="TLJ:TVD" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Tritt Opan was portrayed by [[Patrick O'Kane]] in the [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], the second installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[sequel trilogy]].<ref>{{Film|VIII}}</ref> His first name was first provided by its tie-in reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]''.<ref name="TLJ:TVD" />

In the [[2020]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Book of Lists]]'' by [[Cole Horton]], Captain [[Moden Canady]] was mistakenly identified as Tritt Opan.<ref name="Lists">''[[Star Wars: Book of Lists]]''</ref>
